label: Module tilt (facing north)
basis: Not public. Fixed tilt confirmed (secondary). 10 deg equator-facing base case; 5-15 deg tested in the sensitivity chart.

label: Module azimuth
basis: Not public. North-facing assumed.

label: Ground coverage ratio (row spacing)
basis: Row spacing not public. Higher GCR means more row-to-row shading.

label: Row width (module slant length)
basis: Sets row pitch together with GCR; layout not public.

label: Module height above water
basis: 1:1 modular HDPE float per module; exact height not public.

label: Water/float albedo
basis: Affects ground-reflected light on the front side.

label: Bifacial rear-side gain
basis: Modules are bifacial (datasheet bifaciality 80 +/- 5%), but water reflects little; plant-specific gain not public.

label: Cell heat-loss coefficient Uc (cooling)
basis: Cirata U-value not public. PVsyst free-standing default is about 29; FPV field studies are higher.

label: Power temperature coefficient
basis: Jinko Tiger Neo datasheet -0.30 %/degC (not Cirata-specific).

label: Soiling loss
basis: Likely higher in the Jul-Oct dry season; modelled as an annual constant.

label: Mismatch, DC wiring and wave motion
basis: Typical design-tool defaults widened for float movement.

label: First-year module degradation
basis: Jinko warranty: 99% after year 1.

label: Annual degradation after year 1
basis: Jinko warranty: 0.40%/yr linear to 87.4% at year 30.

label: Extra degradation from humid over-water environment
basis: No reliable published value; placeholder range. Negligible in operating year 1.

label: Inverter nominal efficiency
basis: Inverter make/model not public; typical central inverter range.

label: AC loss to export point (600 V to 20 kV to 150 kV)
basis: Transformer and cable losses not public.

label: Availability (uptime)
basis: Not public. Only qualitative fault history (20 kV cable terminations, ground faults). Curtailment not modelled.

label: DC capacity
basis: Reported

label: Inverter AC capacity (49 x 3,125 kW)
basis: First clipping stage

label: Export limit
basis: Second clipping stage

label: Location
basis: Approximate: these are dam coordinates kept as a placeholder because the array centroid is not published; to be traced from Sentinel-2 imagery.

label: Altitude
basis: Reservoir full supply level is +220 m; PVGIS terrain data gives 219 m at this point.

label: PPA tariff
basis: Secondary; indexation and deemed dispatch not public

label: Capital cost
basis: Rp1.7 trillion (official remarks); US$129M (Jakarta Post 2020, IPB thesis); US$143M (Listrik Indonesia). Unverified.

label: Household use (ESDM-derived)
basis: Inference from primary: ESDM 2024: PLN household sales 130,433,102 MWh / 85,844,540 electrified households.
